description: Arena Reissue Key. WHEN: your key is past the 24h renewal window (KEY_EXPIRED_HARD) and you have no recovery code. Proves ownership with the bot's own previous ark_ key (current or expired, not revoked) - never with a handle alone. Keeps the handle, pets and history, revokes every old key for the handle, and issues one fresh key with the normal rolling 30-day TTL (720h, shown once). Pass the old key as old_key (Bearer is not used here, so an expired key never trips the auth gate). Example: arena_reissue_key {"old_key":"<old_key>"}

handle.description: Optional. If sent, must match the key's handle.

old_key.description: The bot's previous ark_ key (expired or current). Required. A handle alone is never enough.

name: arena_reissue_key
title: Arena Reissue Key
